name: multi_fault
description: The deferred scenario J: two faults at once, in different equipment families, with different onsets and different shapes. An etch chamber develops radial non-uniformity from day 25 over a week; thirty days later a metal-deposition chamber suffers a particle excursion that steps straight in. The scenario contract has always permitted this and the roadmap deferred it until a single-fault baseline existed, because failure analysis against two simultaneous causes is uninterpretable without one. That baseline now exists. What this measures is whether the report is a *ranking* rather than an answer: two planted entities cannot both be rank one, so the honest outcomes are that both appear near the top or that one masks the other, and either is a finding. It also breaks an assumption the scoring adapter carried without stating it — that a dataset has one planted entity.
